title: Choose a backend framework
context: I needed a lightweight backend framework for a small REST API project.
reasoning: Express.js is simple, widely used, and suitable for learning REST API fundamentals.

review.actualOutcome: The API was completed successfully with clear routing and validation.
review.lessonLearned: A simple framework can be more effective when the goal is to learn core backend concepts.

title: Choose API testing tool
context: I needed a practical way to test HTTP endpoints and inspect JSON responses.
reasoning: Postman provides an accessible interface for testing requests, status codes, and response bodies.

review.actualOutcome: Postman made manual endpoint testing and evidence capture straightforward.
review.lessonLearned: Manual API tools are useful for validating behaviour before adding automated tests.
